news.title: International Students from Africa Lead Campus Cultural Showcase
news.summary_en:
Saint Louis University African international students took center stage at the recent "Echoes of Africa" showcase, demonstrating exceptional spirit of leadership, community impact, and cultural awareness.

news.title: Chaifetz Center for Entrepreneurship to Hold 2026 Entrepreneurship Hall of Fame December 3
news.summary_en: The Chaifetz Center for Entrepreneurship at Saint Louis University will hold its 2026 Entrepreneurship Hall of Fame induction ceremony at a dinner on Thursday, Dec. 3, at the Richard A. Chaifetz School of Business.
